arguments.command:
python3 << 'EOF'
import math

# Customs net receipts for 1974 (monthly values from the table)
values = [304, 239, 277, 286, 295, 301, 325, 355, 305, 347, 319, 307]

n = len(values)
print(f"Number of months: {n}")
print(f"Values: {values}")

# Calculate mean
mean = sum(values) / n
print(f"Mean: {mean}")

# Calculate population standard deviation
# Population SD uses n (not n-1)
variance = sum((x - mean) ** 2 for x in values) / n
sd = math.sqrt(variance)
print(f"Population Standard Deviation: {sd}")

# Calculate Coefficient of Variation (CV)
cv = (sd / mean) * 100
print(f"Coefficient of Variation: {cv}%")

# Round to nearest hundredths
cv_rounded = round(cv, 2)
print(f"CV rounded to nearest hundredths: {cv_rounded}%")
EOF
